reviews.title: Brave"-themed version of DuckDuckGo
reviews.pros: Anonymous, privacy centered search, not unlike DuckDuckGo.  Built by the team that made the brave browser, which makes sense - that's a privacy centered browser! UI is well made.
reviews.cons: It's not as well known and is in beta stage so it just needs time to improve.  It uses (anonymous) Google searches as a fallback when it doesn't yield good search results itself (if you enable that setting).
reviews.overall: I don't see much difference between this and DuckDuckGo, but I am all for more anonymous web searching tools out there.
